entities.title: Laumufarþegi Worker
entities.summary: The Cloudflare Worker at icelander.net/games/fresh/laumufarthegi and its Room Durable Object, one per room.
entities.purpose: index.ts routes the page, api/me, api/rooms and each room's WebSocket, and checks the sign-in only for starting a room; room.ts is the Room Durable Object, which keeps a room's state, takes its players' hibernatable WebSockets, applies their actions through shared/game.ts, sends each player their own view, runs the timers on its alarm and deletes an idle room.
boundaries: The rules are shared/game.ts; this folder stores, sequences and delivers them, and decides nothing about the game itself.
Sign-in is icelander.net's login service, reached through vendor/icelander-auth (never edited here) and the ACCOUNTS service binding.
No database and no secrets: a room lives only in its object's storage.
